gloss_en: Attaining the spiritual perception (hasagah) that enables the wise man to illuminate both the great and the small — lowering the lofty with the perception of 'What have you seen?' (mah) and raising the lowly with 'the whole earth is full of His glory' (Likutey Moharan II:7)
canonical_he: כשזוכה להשגה כזו, להאיר בגדולים וקטנים
